title: Analyst - User Research
description:
**Senior Analyst - User Research - IN**  
The role will be required to get an understanding of users' needs, goals and pain points with a particular product or service. Study and analyze customer feedback received through quantitative/qualitative surveys and provide appropriate actionable insights to help the respective product teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities and Duties**

* Define goals, scope, and plan a research based on the business/product/design requirements and conduct appropriate research (moderated/unmoderated) research in the given timeline.
* Provide support to other researchers and studies to analyze the users’ data, derive insights, and define opportunity areas.
* Chose the right research methodology regarding research study and create a continuous research practice within the team and process to deliver regular user research reports.

**Educational Requirements**

* University (Degree) Preferred

**Work Experience**

* No Experience Required

**Physical Requirements**

* Physical Requirements: Sedentary Work

  
**Career Level**  
5IC  
  
Related SkillsAnalytical Skills, Audience-focused Communication, Collaboration, Communication, Content Development, Copywriting, Data-Based Decision Making, Detail-Oriented, Econometrics, Economic Analysis, Financial Forecasting, Financial Modeling, Market/Industry Dynamics, Prioritizes Effectively, Problem Solving, Research Synthesization, Statistics
